card.title: C = ε₀A/d — storing charge, field and energy

rows.label: Concept
rows.text: Capacitance (C = Q/V, farad) prices a conductor's charge-holding ability per volt. A parallel-plate capacitor uniforms the field (E = σ/ε₀) between plates; series combinations share charge while parallel share voltage. Charging stores energy in the FIELD itself (½CV²), and a dielectric multiplies capacitance by polarising against the field.

rows.label: Formula
rows.text: C = Q/V  ·  parallel plate: C = ε₀A/d (dielectric: ×K)  ·  series: 1/C = Σ1/Cᵢ · parallel: C = ΣCᵢ  ·  energy U = ½QV = ½CV² = Q²/2C  ·  6 μF at 100 V: U = ½×6×10⁻⁶×10⁴ = 0.03 J

rows.label: Conditions
rows.text: C = ε₀A/d needs plate dimensions ≫ separation (uniform field, negligible fringing). Series/parallel rules assume ideal wires and isolated combinations. Dielectric factor K applies to fully-filled gaps; partial filling needs series/parallel slicing of the gap.

rows.label: Special cases
rows.text: 1 F is enormous — real capacitors live in pF–mF. Isolated charged capacitor + dielectric insertion: Q fixed, V drops by K, energy drops (work done polarising). Battery-connected insertion: V fixed, Q and energy rise by K. Spherical/earth capacitance extends the idea beyond plates.

rows.label: Solved
rows.text: Parallel-plate derivation (NEB 2023, 5 marks): E = σ/ε₀ = Q/(Aε₀); V = Ed = Qd/(Aε₀); C = Q/V = ε₀A/d. With dielectric K: C = Kε₀A/d. Energy check: 6 μF at 100 V stores ½ × 6×10⁻⁶ × 100² = 0.03 J (NEB 2022, 3 marks).

rows.label: Limitation
rows.text: Every dielectric has a breakdown field — exceed it and the capacitor shorts. Formulas ignore edge fringing and lead inductance (fatal at high frequency). Electrolytics are polarised (DC, correct terminals only); leakage drains ideal U = ½CV² over time.

rows.label: Derivation
rows.text: Gauss pillbox on one plate: E·A = Q/ε₀ → E = σ/ε₀ uniform. Potential across gap d: V = ∫E·dl = Ed. Capacitance C = Q/V = Q/(Qd/Aε₀) = ε₀A/d. Energy: charge incrementally, dW = V·dq = (q/C)dq → U = ∫₀^Q (q/C)dq = Q²/2C.

rows.label: Shortcut
rows.text: Series: same Q, voltages split, reciprocal sum (result SMALLER than smallest). Parallel: same V, charges add. Energy: pick the form matching knowns (½CV² for V-known, Q²/2C for isolated). 'Derive parallel-plate' → E, then V, then C — three lines.

rows.label: Board question
rows.text: NEB 2023 (5): define capacitance + derive parallel-plate C. NEB 2022 (3): 6 μF at 100 V — stored energy. Series/parallel equivalents and dielectric-effect reasoning complete the set.
